strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal cross-platform VPN whose logical weak-network behavior approaches UDP/QUIC while public carriers remain stock REALITY/Vision over real kernel TCP.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: M3 one real TCP lane abstraction
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not add multiple lanes, scheduling, FEC/RBC, Xray/REALITY integration or TUN until one real localhost TCP carrier can stream multiple WBD frames correctly across arbitrary TCP segmentation/coalescing and clean shutdown.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed M2-001: added a deterministic, goroutine-safe logical receive engine. STREAM now supports bounded out-of-order buffering, contiguous delivery, reinjection/duplicate suppression, overlap conflict detection, transactional FIN/final-offset consistency and per-flow type safety. DATAGRAM now supports logical deduplication, hard-deadline expiry and deterministic pruning via ManualClock. Local go vet, normal/race Go tests, handoff verification and continuity tests all passed.
continuation_cursor.current_task: M3-001: implement exactly one real TCP lane abstraction plus incremental frame streaming on localhost; no multi-lane scheduler, FEC/RBC, Xray or TUN.
continuation_cursor.why_now: Logical STREAM/DATAGRAM semantics are now independent of carrier behavior. The next uncertainty is whether the existing frame envelope and receiver survive real TCP byte-stream segmentation/coalescing and bidirectional socket lifecycle without adding transport policy.
continuation_cursor.done_when: Local tests use real 127.0.0.1 TCP sockets to exchange multiple DATA/DATAGRAM/ACK/GAP_HINT frames in both directions, with an incremental bounded decoder that tolerates fragmented and coalesced writes, rejects malformed/oversize frames, and closes without goroutine/socket leaks while all M1/M2 tests remain green.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: M3-001: add a bounded incremental WBD frame reader/writer and a single real TCP lane wrapper; qualify it with 127.0.0.1 client/server tests that deliberately fragment/coalesce frames and exercise bidirectional close; do not add multiple lanes, scheduling, FEC/RBC, Xray or TUN.
